split_rules: Assign task aliases and decision slots before outcomes; no continuation-level random splitting.
New states from seen tasks require independently seeded discovery, disjoint trajectories and distinct pre-action input fingerprints, plus an accepted training state from the same task.

Previously collected124 states are training eligible with their actual3/5 draw counts. Their task groups stay out of unseen-task validation/test; genuinely distinct independently seeded new states may enter seen-task validation.
All actions, draws and retries stay with their state. Unseen-task validation and locked test hold out entire task groups.
Unseen refers to the new selector fit, not guaranteed backbone or actor pretraining exclusion.

Protected benchmark exact task/normalized-goal overlap audit passed; semantic near-duplicate/pretraining exclusion is not established. Historical selector dev/future/retention and joint-validation labels are study-specific, retained unchanged; reuse prevents independent evaluation on those reused historical sets.
Depth-slot and role admission may depend on replay checks but never continuation successes, ties or teacher preference.

collection_protocol.replay: unchanged strict observable-state checks; all forty isolated contexts ready before candidate dispatch
collection_protocol.candidate_intervention: full sampled response including reasoning/action in continuation history

selector_fit.target: Per candidate native successes / actual valid committed draws, preserving success and valid counts; applies to retained historical and newly collected states.
selector_fit.loss: mean independent sigmoid/binomial BCE on the five candidate index logits at a fixed output prefix
selector_fit.primary_invalid_handling: User amendment 2026-10-08: exclude native invalid observations from targets and success-rate denominators; preserve raw outcomes, reasons and all costs. No selective retries.
selector_fit.secondary: Previously published operational invalid-as-zero analyses remain immutable historical estimates; distinguish them from new valid-only estimates.
selector_fit.input: pre-action goal, screenshot, allowed causal history and fixed candidate panel only
selector_fit.implementation_status: loss adapter and GPU parity/save-reload validation still required
selector_fit.interpretation: outcome adaptation of a teacher-pretrained selector, not purely outcome-only pretraining
selector_fit.zero_valid_draws: Null target; mask this candidate from loss. Keep other measured candidates in the state.
selector_fit.valid_native_zeros: Keep valid unsuccessful outcomes, including native unjudged action-limit zeros.

evaluation.primary: Valid-only continuation success of the learned selected action, separately on seen-task/new-state and unseen-task validation; report actual valid denominator and omitted measurements.
evaluation.oracle_reference: Select using valid observations within the first six draws; score valid observations in the final two; tie-break without held-out outcomes.
evaluation.uncertainty: resample whole task groups; preserve paired states, candidates and draws
evaluation.checkpoint_selection: validation only, with selected-checkpoint validation scores labeled selection-biased; final locked task test untouched
evaluation.controls: No claim of superiority over matched teacher-label training without that additional training control. Frozen judge semantic limitations remain.
evaluation.paired_coverage: For paired full-five reference comparisons use common states with at least one valid selection and one valid held-out draw per candidate. Report omitted states and actual counts; never renormalize the five-entry candidate set after seeing held-out validity.
evaluation.validity_limitation: Conditional on measurement availability, which may differ by candidate; not directly comparable to historical operational invalid-as-zero rates.

pilot_request.admission_gate: validate forty-context resource ownership and strict replay before scaling; reserve budget for a whole group and cleanup
pilot_request.zero_yield_stop: pause for diagnosis if first 24 resolved replay groups have zero accepted states; not a statistical proof of infeasibility
pilot_request.retries: charge all failed/rejected attempts and retain first-cause evidence; no full-budget reset
pilot_request.cpu_reduction_reason: Scheduler submission policy allows at most8CPUs perGPU; all othercaps unchanged.

feasibility.warning: Eight-draw all-context acceptance has been observed in the pilot, but full32state yield is not guaranteed. Three slots on2090 tasks provide5670 collectible opportunities. Expand source coverage or slots only after role/depth-specific yield and cost review.
feasibility.larger_source_pool_status: metadata available; requires separate exclusions/source audit and budget approval

validation.scope: Original eight-draw pilot startup and initialcollections verified; extra24 GPUstartup pending. Neitherendpoint fullyaudited.

historical_reuse_caveat.decision: Reuse permitted for this new fit as requested; no claim of independence on reused historical evaluation sets.

primary_questions: Does immediate post-action evidence improve the critic on independent continuation outcomes?
Can post-action teacher choices improve a student that sees only pre-action information?
research_priority.matched_teacher_comparison: Same frozen critic, candidate set, prompt and repeated index-only protocol; post condition adds bound immediate execution evidence from a prespecified draw; no future suffix, terminal screenshot or outcomes.
research_priority.matched_students: Same initialization, training states, pre-action inputs, loss and optimization budget; targets are repeated pre-action versus post-action teacher choice distributions.
research_priority.return_signal_control: Retain separately labeled continuation-return supervision; do not equate oracle outcome selection with post-action critic performance.
research_priority.scaling_gate: Audit valid panel yield, immediate evidence availability, depth coverage and all-attempt costs; prepare separate exact collection, labeling and training requests while current collection continues.

extra24_extension.admission: Append only independently audited states in parent acceptance order; max32, no outcome filtering or proposal regeneration.

comparison.tie_handling: exact uniform expectation over fitting-only tied winners
comparison.coverage: common fixed-five valid fitting/heldout panel; no heldout-validity renormalization; report excluded states
comparison.uncertainty: Planned paired whole-task bootstrap; split identities preserved.
comparison.interpretation: Fixed proposal and continuation-policy reference; all32same-data maximum is optimistic hindsight.
